attackSurface.changes.description: Hosts, ports, certificates, DNS records, technologies and exposures that changed on your external attack surface. Only assets you can see are listed.
attackSurface.changes.empty: No host, port, certificate, DNS, technology or exposure change in this window.
attackSurface.changes.emptyFiltered: No change of the selected kinds in this window.
attackSurface.changes.noAccess: You do not have permission to view assets. Ask your administrator for access.
